arxiv-2011-14468.title: Discrete gravity dynamics from effective spin foams
arxiv-2011-14468.creator: Seth K. Asante, Bianca Dittrich, Hal M. Haggard
arxiv-2011-14468.description: Abstract The first computation of a spin foam dynamics that provides a test of the quantum equations of motions of gravity is presented. Specifically, a triangulation that includes an inner edge is treated. The computation leverages the recently introduced effective spin foam models, which are particularly numerically efficient.

arxiv-2102-07124.title: Electroweak monopoles and magnetic dumbbells in grand unified theories
arxiv-2102-07124.creator: G. Lazarides, Q. Shafi
arxiv-2102-07124.description: Abstract We use the S ​ U ​ ( 5 ) SU(5) model to show the presence in grand unified theories of an electroweak monopole and a magnetic dumbbell (“meson”) made up of a monopole-antimonopole pair connected by a Z Z -magnetic flux tube.

arxiv-2302-04743.title: A Constant-per-Iteration Likelihood Ratio Test for Online Changepoint Detection for Exponential Family Models
arxiv-2302-04743.creator: Kes Ward
arxiv-2302-04743.description: Abstract Online changepoint detection algorithms that are based on likelihood-ratio tests have been shown to have excellent statistical properties. However, a simple online implementation is computationally infeasible as, at time T T , it involves considering O ⁡ ( T ) O(T) possible locations for the change.

arxiv-2309-16545.title: Bounding mean orders of sub- k k -trees of k k -trees
arxiv-2309-16545.creator: Stijn Cambie, Bradley McCoy, Stephan Wagner, Corrine Yap
arxiv-2309-16545.description: Abstract For a k k -tree T T , we prove that the maximum local mean order is attained in a k k -clique of degree 1 1 and that it is not more than twice the global mean order.

arxiv-2311-18504.title: Surge of Power Transmission in Flat and Nearly Flat Band Lattices
arxiv-2311-18504.creator: H. Susanto, N. Lazarides, I. Kourakis
arxiv-2311-18504.description: Abstract Flat band systems can yield interesting phenomena due to their completely flat band, such as dispersion suppression of waves with frequency at the band. While linear transport vanishes, the corresponding nonlinear case is still an open question. Here, we study power transmission along nonlinear sawtooth lattices due to waves with the flat band frequency injected at one end.

arxiv-2402-17124.title: Fact-and-Reflection (FaR) Improves Confidence Calibration of Large Language Models
arxiv-2402-17124.creator: Xinran Zhao, Hongming Zhang, Xiaoman Pan, Wenlin Yao, Dong Yu, Tongshuang Wu, Jianshu Chen
arxiv-2402-17124.description: Abstract For a LLM to be trustworthy, its confidence level should be well calibrated with its actual performance. While it is now common sense that LLM performances are greatly impacted by prompts, the confidence calibration in prompting LLMs has yet to be thoroughly explored.

arxiv-2403-19695.title: Classification of quasi-affine Generalized Dynkin Diagrams with Rank > 5 >5
arxiv-2403-19695.creator: Zhengtang Tan, Shouchuan Zhang a a .School of Engineering and Design, Hunan Normal UniversityChangsha 410081, P.R. China b b . Department of Mathematics, Hunan UniversityChangsha 410082, P.R. China Emails: z9491@sina.cn (SZ); 1843186255@qq.com (ZTT)
arxiv-2403-19695.description: Abstract All quasi-affine connected Generalized Dynkin Diagrams with rank > 5 >5 are found. All quasi-affine Nichols (Lie braided) algebras with rank > 5 >5 are also found. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification : 16W30, 16G10 Keywords : Quasi-affine, Nichols algebra, Generalized Dynkin Diagram, Arithmetic GDD.

arxiv-2406-15184.title: Ivo G. Rosenberg’s Work on Maximal Clones and Minimal Clones
arxiv-2406-15184.creator: Ágnes Szendrei
arxiv-2406-15184.description: Abstract . The aim of this paper is to honor Ivo G. Rosenberg by describing some of his most influential results and their impact in logic, discrete mathematics, algebra, and computer science. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary: 08A40; Secondary: 08B50, 08A05, 08A70, 68Q25 1.

arxiv-2509-14224.title: Possible Evidence for the Presence of Volatiles on the Warm Super-Earth TOI-270 b
arxiv-2509-14224.creator: Louis-Philippe Coulombe, Björn Benneke, Joshua Krissansen-Totton, Alexandrine L’Heureux, Caroline Piaulet-Ghorayeb, Michael Radica, Pierre-Alexis Roy, Eva-Maria Ahrer, Charles Cadieux, Yamila Miguel, Hilke E. Schlichting, Elisa Delgado-Mena, Christopher Monaghan, Hanna Adamski, Eshan Raul, Ryan Clou
arxiv-2509-14224.description: Abstract The search for atmospheres on rocky exoplanets is a crucial step in understanding the processes driving atmosphere formation, retention, and loss. Past studies have revealed the existence of planets interior to the radius valley with densities lower than would be expected for pure-rock compositions, indicative of the presence of large volatile inventories which could facilitate atmosphere retention.

pmc-10552957.title: Cost-effectiveness of virtual reality and wet laboratory cataract surgery simulation
pmc-10552957.creator: Danny S. Ng, Benjamin H. K. Yip, Alvin L. Young, Wilson W. K. Yip, Nai M. Lam, Kenneth K. Li, Simon T. Ko, Wai H. Chan, Orapan Aryasit, Shameema Sikder, John D. Ferris, Chi P. Pang, Clement C. Tham
pmc-10552957.description: Purpose:To evaluate the cost-effectiveness of phacoemulsification simulation training in virtual reality simulator and wet laboratory on operating theater performance.Methods:Residents were randomized to a combination of virtual reality and wet laboratory phacoemulsification or wet laboratory phacoemulsification. A reference control group consisted of trainees who had wet laboratory training without phacoemulsification.

pmc-11401018.title: Downstaging of advanced hepatocellular carcinoma followed by liver transplantation using immune checkpoint inhibitors: Where do we stand?
pmc-11401018.creator: Hirak Pahari, Javid A Peer, Shikhar Tripathi, Suresh K Singhvi, Ushast Dhir
pmc-11401018.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Liver transplantation (LT) in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and chronic liver disease (CLD) is limited by factors such as tumor size, number, portal venous or hepatic venous invasion and extrahepatic disease.

pmc-11672146.title: Concatenating Microbial, Enzymatic, and Organometallic Catalysis for Integrated Conversion of Renewable Carbon Sources
pmc-11672146.creator: Nina Klos, Ole Osterthun, Hendrik G. Mengers, Patrick Lanzerath, William Graf von Westarp, Guiyeoul Lim, Marcel Gausmann, Jan-Dirk Küsters-Spöring, Jan Wiesenthal, Nils Guntermann, Lars Lauterbach, Andreas Jupke, Walter Leitner, Lars M. Blank, Jürgen Klankermayer, Dörte Rother
pmc-11672146.description: The chemical industry can now seize the opportunity to improve the sustainability of its processes by replacing fossil carbon sources with renewable alternatives such as CO2, biomass, and plastics, thereby thinking ahead and having a look into the future. For their conversion to intermediate and final products, different types of catalysts—microbial, enzymatic, and organometallic—can be applied.

pmc-12456754.title: Anti-Arthritis and Biosafety Properties of Green Synthesized Zinc Oxide Nanoparticles Loaded with Cedrus libani Extract
pmc-12456754.creator: Diana Battal Mejjo, Ream Nayal, Wassim Abdelwahed, Mohammad Yaser Abajy
pmc-12456754.description: PurposeThis research was conducted to develop an easy and safe method for synthesizing zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnO NPs) with the aim of enhancing the efficacy and biosafety of ethanolic Cedrus libani (CL) extract and its aqueous fraction (ACL), as a potential preclinical candidate for anti-arthritis applications.

pmc-12608694.title: Anterior Odontoid Screw Fixation for Trauma: Case Series and Technical Considerations
pmc-12608694.creator: Federica Figà, Marcello Nunzio Tirendi, Andrea Talacchi, Alessandro Olivi
pmc-12608694.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Odontoid fractures—prevalently Anderson–D’Alonzo type II—are clinically relevant for their biomechanical instability and risk of non-union. Posterior C1–C2 fusion yields the highest fusion rates but sacrifices atlantoaxial rotation. Anterior odontoid screw fixation (AOSF) enables direct osteosynthesis while preserving motion. This study aimed to evaluate the radiographic outcomes, fusion rate, and technical considerations of AOSF in a consecutive single-center series, highlighting anatomical and procedural factors influencing bone healing.

pmc-12617760.title: Optimization of siRNA therapeutics targeting MIAT for cardioprotection in myocardial ischemia/reperfusion injury
pmc-12617760.creator: Xiao-Rong Ma, Tong-Meng Yan, Yu Pan, Zhi-Hong Jiang
pmc-12617760.description: Myocardial ischemia/reperfusion (MI/R) injury is a leading cause of heart failure, and novel therapeutic strategies are urgently needed to improve patient outcomes. Long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) myocardial infarction-associated transcript (MIAT) has been implicated in exacerbating myocardial damage during ischemia, making it an attractive target for RNA interference.

pmc-12972566.title: Breaking Down the Posteromedial Corner: Medial Collateral Ligament Augmentation
pmc-12972566.creator: Cameron Gerhold, Ali Can Koluman, Jose Vega, Fernando Gómez Verdejo, Robert LaPrade, Jorge Chahla
pmc-12972566.description: Background:The medial collateral ligament (MCL) is often injured after a valgus stress is applied to the knee, which stresses the medial compartment. Pivoting and rotational movements during sports frequently cause MCL injuries.Indication:Selection of a surgical treatment option depends on the chronicity of the MCL injury, lower-limb axis alignment, the grade of the MCL injury, and other patient-specific factors.

pmc-13302816.title: Fabrication of Structured Surface Functional Layers for Enhanced Performance of Ag2Se-Based Photothermoelectric Detectors
pmc-13302816.creator: Gailing Tian, Rui Guo, Yun Gong, Wenjing Zhang, Weipeng Shi, Yi Chen, Yonghua Wang, Jinglong Wen, Dan Liu, Chenyang Xue

pmc-13381923.title: Cascade of magnetic-field-induced quantum spin states in a spin-1 honeycomb magnet
pmc-13381923.creator: Kaixin Tang, Zhao-Yang Dong, Yanyan Shangguan, Zhao Gong, Ye Yang, Song Bao, Houpu Li, Nan Zhang, Hongyu Li, Jian-Xin Li, Jinsheng Wen, Ziji Xiang, Xianhui Chen
pmc-13381923.description: Quantum fluctuations endow spin systems with surprisingly enriched magnetic phase diagrams. In frustrated magnets, strong quantum fluctuations boosted by either geometrical incompatibility or competitive exchange interactions stabilize cascades of unusual phases of matter. Here we reveal the presence of multiple quantum phases in the honeycomb antiferromagnet Na3Ni2BiO6, both inside and beyond its field-induced one-third magnetization plateau.

pmc-13416078.title: Distinct NK cell dynamics in SARIFA positive colorectal cancer patients indicate persistent patient-intrinsic immune signatures after tumor resection
pmc-13416078.creator: Florian Sommer, Lena Anthuber, Bianca Grosser, Phillip Löhr, Andreas Rank, Eva-Maria Allmendinger, Lisa Siebenhüter, Nic G. Reitsam, Bruno Märkl, Johanna Waidhauser

pmc-13548265.title: What neighbourhood factors support more transport walking as adults age? A five-wave longitudinal multilevel cohort study in Brisbane, Australia
pmc-13548265.creator: Tharindu Niwarthana Bandara, Gavin Turrell, Alysha De Livera, Belen Zapata-Diomedi, Lucy Gunn
pmc-13548265.description: IntroductionTransport walking is a simple, cost-effective and sustainable way to promote physical activity that integrates movement into daily routines. A supportive built environment, including walkable areas—consisting of high residential density, good street connectivity and mixed land-uses—is associated with greater transport walking, making it a critical area for urban planning and policy interventions.
